title: qshap: Fast Shapley Decomposition of $R^2$ for Gradient-Boosted Trees
abstract: arXiv:2608.24104v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Numerous methods have been developed to quantify feature attributions in individual predictions for tree ensembles. However, many applications require global measures of feature contributions to overall model performance. Although local attribution scores can be aggregated to characterize feature importance, such summaries do not directly decompose measures of predictive performance, such as $R^2$. This article introduces qshap, available in both R and Python, which provides Shapley decomposition of $R^2$ values for gradient-boosted decision trees (GBDTs) to quantify feature-specific contributions to model performance. By decomposing the quadratic loss of individual observations, qshap provides flexible tools to explore the importance of individual features and observations. qshap currently supports widely used GBDT implementations, including xgboost, lightgbm, and catboost, through a unified tree representation and efficient C++ backe

translated_title: qshap：梯度提升树的$R^2$快速Shapley分解
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24104v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：已有大量方法用于量化树集成模型中单个预测的特征归因。然而，许多应用需要特征对整体模型性能贡献的全局度量。尽管局部归因分数可以聚合以表征特征重要性，但此类汇总并不能直接分解预测性能的度量，如$R^2$。本文介绍了qshap，该工具同时提供R和Python版本，它实现了对梯度提升决策树（GBDTs）中$R^2$值的Shapley分解，以量化特征对模型性能的特定贡献。通过分解单个观测的二次损失，qshap提供了灵活的工具来探索单个特征和观测的重要性。qshap目前支持广泛使用的GBDT实现，包括xgboost、lightgbm和catboost，通过统一的树表示和高效的C++后端实现。
tldr: qshap是一种新工具，通过Shapley分解梯度提升树中的$R^2$值，实现特征和观测对模型性能贡献的全局量化。
en_tdlr: qshap is a novel tool that decomposes $R^2$ values in gradient-boosted trees via Shapley values, enabling global quantification of feature and observation contributions to model performance.
